_note: Inkling-2-Mini UD-Q4_K_XL on M1 Max 32GB. Sizes from the GGUF header (tools/gguf_meta.py). Looping: 24 stored layers, 48 applications per token (layers 6-17 run 3x), so per-token reads count dense and expert weights per application: dense 0.836 GB x 48/24 = 1.672; experts 15.798 GB x 48/24 = 31.596 at top-8 of 128. Bandwidth = measured MLX read (tools/hwbench.py). KV: 8 global-attention applications x 8 KV heads x 128 x (K+V) x 2 B (f16) = 32768 B/token; the 40 sliding-window applications cap at 1024 tokens and are left out. Draft rows are illustrative: DSpark drafter (0.40 GB Q8_0, borrows the target LM head), acceptance unknown until measured.
